Sentence (English): This is my second Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Dream Dishwasher (rate a 4.5) ] || ---------------- || This is my second Bosch dishwasher. My first one is in the home we sold 6 yrs ago. So, when it came time to replace the dishwasher in my current home, I knew I wanted a Bosch. Takes a few uses to get used to how arrange dishes but the versatility of folding down some racks is nice. Love how quiet it is when it runs. We have an open kitchen so running our old dishwasher and watching TV at the same time was difficult. The only reason I did not give this machine 5 stars is there is no indicator light on the front of the machine to notify people if the machine is running or set to run. There have been several times when I've set a delayed start and a family member opens the machine to put a dish in and then the cycle gets terminated or delay start is negated. Other than that small critique, the dishwasher is wonderful.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher itself is very impressive.
Comments (English): [ Great product. Awful service. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher itself is very impressive. I don't think I've ever owned a dishwasher that makes everything sparkle like this one does. I do use the heavy duty and sanitize settings. I also use cascade pods, even though the tech advised against using them. It is VERY quiet. And the third shelf comes in handy for spatulas, etc. I will admit I sometimes forget to empty that rack! One downside is that it takes a VERY long time to run (just under 5 hours) compared to the two I am used to. I had to give it four stars, even though the product is deserving of 10/5 because I will never purchase an appliance from Best Buy ever again. It was an absolute nightmare to get installed. Week 1: installer was running behind and I needed to leave so we had to push back to the following week. Week 2: Installer arrived. Did not realize we had granite countertops and needed a different installation kit, which needs to be ordered. I don't know a lot about installing appliances but I feel like granite is not uncommon and the question should have been asked when we purchased. Week 3: Rearranged scheduled yet again only to receive and email (no call or text) that installation was moved to following week. Week 4: Finally installed. After many hours on the phone with customer service call center managers (and in store with store manager) my husband continued to receive the same response. “We don't control delivery; another vendor handles that.” Bottom line: Best Buy will have zero second thoughts about taking your money. They will not hold themselves accountable for the follow through; just point fingers at the vendor (that they hired and pay).

Sentence (English): I've purchased four Bosch dishwashers through the years and have noticed changes for the worse.
Comments (English): [ Not as good as years past ] || ---------------- || I've purchased four Bosch dishwashers through the years and have noticed changes for the worse. The newer design appears to be done by those that don't do dishes at home. The 800 series is over designed. Way too many options to flip this and fold down that. This takes away from a tactile sense of build quality. The middle shelf is marketed as being an improvement over previous designs. Actually it feels so wobbly as to appear loose or installed incorrectly which is not the case. Just loosely goosey. Many of the flexible optional features are never used. Also the 800 series appears to be harder on the dishes causing graphics on prized coffee mugs to get etched and faded. I'm assuming this is a combination of higher temperatures for longer durations with more chemically aggressive tablets (we've always used the recommended Jet Dry brand). Programming it is very unintuitive requiring reference to the owners manual which is complicated itself and never received a hard copy. Dishes do get clean but we pre clean. I do like the top shelf. Stainless steel panel for door is rather flimsy,

That said, the internal dimensions of the unit appears to be a little smaller than our old GE. However the dishes stack closer together and still clean well, so that is pretty much a wash. If you use the provided utensil basket in the bottom rack you looses a lot of dish/glass space. We opted to use the 3rd rack for utensils and silverware, but you have to insert them into slots to hold everything in place and that takes more time than just dumping the utensils and silverware into a basket (:-< ...Bosch Dishwasher Bottom line: a good value, works better than our old GE, it should have a better lifecycle than most other brands.... cleans our dishes and dry most everything except some plastic items. Time and use will tell if it was a best choice.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dish washer at the end of March 2023 based on it receiving higher reviews, and I don't know how it has the rating it does.
Comments (English): [ Leaves items wet, bad configuration, not working ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dish washer at the end of March 2023 based on it receiving higher reviews, and I don't know how it has the rating it does. First off, both the top rack for silverware and the silverware carrier will leave all items in them wet. I'm used to being able to remove the silverware carrier, take it to my silverware drawer to unload it, but can't do it with this thing as water is captured in and on top of it, and then leaks all over my hardwood floors. I tried using Extra Dry, but no change. Whirlpool to me this is "normal". Second thing I hate about this unit - the middle shelf where you typically put cups and mugs is configured in a way that your coffee mugs must be all tiny cappucino sized or all wide mouth big gulps, in order to efficiently use the spacing that is done. I know how this sounds, but because I have normal sized mugs, I can fit two less in this dishwasher than my old Maytag it replaced which means I'm running my dishwasher more frequently. And now most recently, there is a still detergent left in the detergent compartment, and down the door after a regular cycle is completed. Sentence (English): Since I'm raising a child alone, I thought I should at least lend a helping hand with the dishes.
Comments (English): [ Aunt is the best ] || ---------------- || Since I'm raising a child alone, I thought I should at least lend a helping hand with the dishes. So I bought a dishwasher. First of all, the visual. My style~ My kitchen has plain white doors, so I chose one that doesn't feel out of place. Everyone says it's so pretty. My dishwasher is also so pretty^^ I paid extra and put it near the sink, and I don't regret it. It has three levels, so I put spoons on the top, small bowls like rice bowls on the second level, and large plates or pots on the bottom. I put plates. I separate the straw cups and put them on the first and second levels. Seriously. I hated washing straw cups the most, but this is a whole new world. It's so clean. I strongly recommend it. I use it once a day, and my electricity and water bills are still the same as usual. The downside is. The panel is in front, so when I'm cooking, I call my aunt without realizing it. Hahaha. I really don't regret choosing a dishwasher^^

Comments (English): [ It washes well. ] || ---------------- || It's my first time using a dishwasher. People who have tried it say it's good or bad, so I don't like installing expensive dishwashers, so I chose a dishwasher that is easy to install and small in size. First, the delivery box arrived safely, but it was so big that the shoe cabinet door didn't fit, so I opened it from the outside and moved it. It's heavy, but not so much that a woman can't hear it. And it's surprisingly big, so it takes up some space, but fortunately it fits on one side, so it's good. Before using, there are inlet and drain hoses, but if you install the drain hose, you can also use the manual inlet, so it's easy to install~You just have to tighten it with a screwdriver at the back, so even a woman can install it alone. The inlet hose can be installed, but I don't like complicated things, so I fill it manually, which is a bit annoying, but it's worth it~ You can just put the sink hose into the inlet tank. The water tray that comes as a gift is surprisingly convenient when putting water in. If you look at the functions, there are standard, strong, eco, sterilization, and quick reservation, but the standard, strong, eco, and sterilization take too much time. It takes 1 hour to 1 hour or more. Honestly, it's not a big dishwasher, so I'm worried about the electricity bill since it only takes 60-80 minutes for a few dishes, and I wonder if it's really practical. I think the quick 30-minute course is good. Most dishes are washed very cleanly even with the quick mode. However, the regrettable thing about the quick mode is that the drying function does not work at all. In this case, I think it would be better to make a separate drying function. And I think it would be good to have manual time control. It's a simple wash in the 20-30 minute mode. The capacity is for 3 people, but it's a good size for 1-2 people living alone or newlyweds. I don't think it'll fit a pot, but it's perfect for washing simple dishes like rice, soup spoons, chopsticks, and cups. And another regrettable thing is that there's no lock. In a house with children, you have to turn it on only when there's no child. The dishwasher door can't be opened. The button is in a place that's easy to press, so they keep pressing it. When not in use, you have to unplug it and keep it in front of you for 30-1 hour while the dishwasher is running. The cleaning power is a mistake if you think of the dishwasher in the past! These days, dishwashers really clean well. Even if you put in a little detergent, it's really clean. Lastly, what's really disappointing is that you have to wash dishes even if you have a dishwasher! I use plastic dishes more than ceramic dishes, but I can't put them all in the dishwasher. The dishes get scratched and damaged after a few turns. The weak dishes crack and the inside feels like it's cracked. I can't even put dishes with bands in them. I have to buy new dishwasher dishes. These days, dishwashers really clean well. Even if you put in a little detergent, it's really clean. Lastly, what's really disappointing is that you have to wash dishes even if you have a dishwasher! I use plastic dishes more than ceramic dishes, but I can't put them all in the dishwasher. The dishes get scratched and damaged after a few turns. Comments (English): [ It washes well. ] || ---------------- || It's my first time using a dishwasher. Before using, there are inlet and drain hoses, but if you install the drain hose, you can also use the manual inlet, so it's easy to install~You just have to tighten it with a screwdriver at the back, so even a woman can install it alone. The water tray that comes as a gift is surprisingly convenient when putting water in. If you look at the functions, there are standard, strong, eco, sterilization, and quick reservation, but the standard, strong, eco, and sterilization take too much time. It takes 1 hour to 1 hour or more. Honestly, it's not a big dishwasher, so I'm worried about the electricity bill since it only takes 60-80 minutes for a few dishes, and I wonder if it's really practical. I think the quick 30-minute course is good. Most dishes are washed very cleanly even with the quick mode. However, the regrettable thing about the quick mode is that the drying function does not work at all. In this case, I think it would be better to make a separate drying function. I don't think it'll fit a pot, but it's perfect for washing simple dishes like rice, soup spoons, chopsticks, and cups. And another regrettable thing is that there's no lock. In a house with children, you have to turn it on only when there's no child. The dishwasher door can't be opened. The button is in a place that's easy to press, so they keep pressing it. When not in use, you have to unplug it and keep it in front of you for 30-1 hour while the dishwasher is running. The cleaning power is a mistake if you think of the dishwasher in the past! These days, dishwashers really clean well. Even if you put in a little detergent, it's really clean. Lastly, what's really disappointing is that you have to wash dishes even if you have a dishwasher! I use plastic dishes more than ceramic dishes, but I can't put them all in the dishwasher. The dishes get scratched and damaged after a few turns. The weak dishes crack and the inside feels like it's cracked. I can't even put dishes with bands in them. I have to buy new dishwasher dishes. It's a shame that there are surprisingly many dishes that can't be put in. This is an honest review after using the product for free as a Coupang Experience Group member. The rinse aid has left my dishes clearer than they have ever been. Glasswear comes out looking brand new, even without the rinse aid. The first day we got it I put all my glasses through a wash cycle because there was such a noticeable difference after just one rinse. The mobile app features are perhaps my favorite part. The app tracks your rinse aid and dishwasher pod quantities, and can reorder them for you through Amazon which is very convenient - I don't even have to think about it and it's been accurate so far. The dishwasher also comes with a water hardness test kit and the app allows you to input water hardness results and will add the correct amount water softener to each load if needed. If you're on the fence about this product, don't be - I am so happy with my decision to purchase it and with Bosch. This is my first Bosch product and I will be a lifelong customer.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher looks nice, the stainless doesn't show fingerprints as advertised, and it is quiet when it runs, but the overall feel is cheap.
Comments (English): [ Nice dishwasher, but feels cheaply made ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher looks nice, the stainless doesn't show fingerprints as advertised, and it is quiet when it runs, but the overall feel is cheap. We replaced an older LG dishwasher with this GE unit. The top buttons on this unit are a bit awkward as I found that I need to roll my fingers a bit in order to find the activation spot. Not a big deal, but worth mentioning. The trays feel like they aren't even meant to fit this machine. The top tray wiggles, moves around and doesn't glide smoothly, and the rails are a bit flimsy. The bottom tray feels similar, except it's the rollers that feel loose. Our old LG had a similar setup, and both trays would glide in and out with minimal effort, and they just felt sturdy. We bought this online and didn't get to check it out in a store first or else I'm sure we would have noticed this. It's a shame that manufacturers are cutting costs wherever they can instead of making a quality product.We found that the only way that this unit will leave plastic wear dry is by using the dry boost function. We had originally left this turned off as the Normal wash cycle was 78 minutes, which seemed great. When opening the unit after this cycle, almost everything inside was very wet (the utensils were dry, but water ran off the bottom of the rack when we picked it up). It seems like units that do not have a heated dry cycle are like this. With the Dry Boost function turned on, the overall wash/dry time increased to either 120 or 180 minutes, depending on which level you choose.

Sentence (English): After using it for 20 days, I would like to share my experience with friends who are waiting and watching.
Comments (English): After using it for 20 days, I would like to share my experience with friends who are waiting and watching. My family generally only cooks three meals for a 2-year-old child, and an adult occasionally has one meal a day. Generally, the lower layer can put down all the bowls of the day, and the lower layer washes for about an hour and a half. The upper or lower layer cannot be washed at the same time as the ventilation function. Turn it on, that is, take out the bowl after single-layer washing, or you need to manually turn on the ventilation function after washing. After 20 days, there is no residue in the filter, and sometimes it will feel smelly when it is opened. Coated pots, plastic products, and large pots need to be washed by hand, because the chopstick cages take up too much space, and I also wash them by myself. The bowls for steaming egg custard, the scale on the stainless steel pot, and the stains that need to be washed off with steel wool. Machine wash does not need to be hand washed. So the dishwasher does not completely free my hands, and it can help me wash half of the things each time. In addition, it takes a lot of time to arrange the tableware. Unless there are very few things to wash, you can arrange them casually. , plus less time to clean up food residue, a bit time-consuming. In the words of a friend who also uses a dishwasher: I have washed all the dishes in that time... So in terms of overall time, I don't feel that I have saved time. There are also advantages, milk stains can be easily cleaned, and the gaps in the pot cover that cannot be washed by hand can also be cleaned for you. Overall, for me, part of the labor is still liberated, but it is far from meeting expectations and not smart enough. Then make complaints about the installation and its unprofessional twists and turns!
Comments (Original): 用了20来天，给观望的朋友们说说使用心得。我家一般只做一个2岁多小孩的三餐，**一个大人偶尔一天中一顿，一般下层可以全部放下当天的碗，下层洗模式一个半小时左右，上层或者下层洗不能和换气功能同时开启，也就是单层洗完要么把碗拿出来，要么等洗完你需要手动开换气功能，不换气的话应该是不行，我家碗都是水预冲很干净才放进去洗的，用了20来天滤网无残渣有时候打开都会感觉有味道。涂层锅、塑料制品、大的锅需要自己手洗，因为筷笼太占地方我也自己洗，蒸蛋羹的碗、不锈钢锅上的水垢、需钢丝球才洗的掉的污渍这几类洗碗机洗不掉需要手洗。所以洗碗机并不能完全解放双手，每次可以帮我洗一半的东西。另外餐具摆放特别费时间，除非洗的东西特别少可以随便摆，不然的话需要费点神安排摆放，在用了这么久以后我每次大概还是要花六七分钟甚至十来分钟摆放，再加少清理食物残渣的时间，有点耗时。用同样使用洗碗机的朋友的话说：有那功夫我碗都洗好了…所以总的用时上来说没有明显感觉到节约了时间。优点也有，牛奶渍可以轻松洗净，锅盖缝隙手洗不到的地方也能给你洗干净。总体对我而言还是解放了一部分劳力，但远没达到预期不够智能。再吐槽下安装及其不专业一波三折！

Comments (English): [ LG does not stand behind defective product. ] || ---------------- || Upon the first use, our LG dishwasher gave the dishes- particularly glassware- a strong smell similar to a riverbank with submerged, slimy roots and vegetation. (Incidentally, a technician told me that if LG has to send someone 3 times for the same issue, the policy is to replace the machine.)For the next 2 years, despite efforts to clean and drain the machine, try different cycles, and various dish washing products, the smell continued to get worse and worse. Eventually, when we opened the dishwasher after any cleaning cycle, our entire downstairs would reek like a riverbank.On 6-23-2023, I tried again to get some satisfaction from LG. After several calls, hours on the phone and weeks of waiting, my case was escalated to the Presidential Liaison. I was told that the best they could do was give me a courtesy check for $100 for my troubles, and a rebate for 20% of the machine cost. I expected $100 plus $206. I did receive the $100 check, and then I received a coupon off the price of my next LG appliance purchase for $58 with a notice that the case was closed. After 2½ years of dealing with stench, we replaced the LG dishwasher with a Bosch model a couple weeks ago – NO MORE SMELL.

The dishes would hold this odor, even when completely dry, unless we rinsed and dried all the dishes by hand or set them all out on the counter for 3 days to air out.On my first 2 warranty service calls to LG, 5-12-21 and 6-7-21, the technicians recognized an odor but could find no mechanical issues with the machine. The 3rd time I called, on 6-7-2021, LG refused to send someone to my house, saying that they would not send someone for the same issue since they found nothing at the last service call. (Incidentally, a technician told me that if LG has to send someone 3 times for the same issue, the policy is to replace the machine.)For the next 2 years, despite efforts to clean and drain the machine, try different cycles, and various dish washing products, the smell continued to get worse and worse. Eventually, when we opened the dishwasher after any cleaning cycle, our entire downstairs would reek like a riverbank.On 6-23-2023, I tried again to get some satisfaction from LG. After several calls, hours on the phone and weeks of waiting, my case was escalated to the Presidential Liaison. I was told that the best they could do was give me a courtesy check for $100 for my troubles, and a rebate for 20% of the machine cost. I expected $100 plus $206. I did receive the $100 check, and then I received a coupon off the price of my next LG appliance purchase for $58 with a notice that the case was closed. After 2½ years of dealing with stench, we replaced the LG dishwasher with a Bosch model a couple weeks ago – NO MORE SMELL.

Sentence (English): Very happy with our new Bosch 300 Series dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Very happy with our new Bosch 300 Series dishwasher. Our previous unit was an older 500 Series with top controls. I much prefer the front controls of this model. Knowing what cycle is selected and when it will finish is a huge upgrade. And I absolutely love the additional silverware rack. It's made unloading silverware so fast and easy. Other pros: extremely quiet; gets dishes clean; the SPEED60 cycle is fast and good; the EXTRA DRY option also makes a big difference in the drying effectiveness of the machine. My only complaint is this: on the old unit, when you opened the door mid-cycle, then shut the door, the dishwasher would automatically resume the cycle. On this unit, after opening the door during a cycle, you must press the START button to resume. Moreover, there is no indication that the cycle has stopped or been resumed, and because the unit is so quiet, it can be hard to tell if you've resumed the cycle. I prefer the old behavior of automatically resuming the cycle. There is no reason I'd not want to do that. Other than that minor nit, though, I'm quite happy with this diswasher. Overall, it's a big improvement over our last machine.

Comments (English): [ Get's the Job Done ] || ---------------- || The Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher SHPM65Z55N is a solid performer that deserves a commendable 4 out of 5 stars. This appliance is a workhorse, consistently delivering clean dishes with every cycle. Its efficiency is noteworthy, tackling stubborn stains and food residues with ease. The design is sleek and modern, fitting seamlessly into any kitchen decor. The dishwasher operates quietly, making it a perfect choice for open-concept kitchens or households that value tranquility. Sentence (English): Upon the first use, our LG dishwasher gave the dishes- particularly glassware- a strong smell similar to a riverbank with submerged, slimy roots and vegetation.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher stinks- literally. No recourse. ] || ---------------- || Upon the first use, our LG dishwasher gave the dishes- particularly glassware- a strong smell similar to a riverbank with submerged, slimy roots and vegetation. At the beginning, the smell would sometimes not occur until about 20 minutes after the cycle ended, but it would last indefinitely on dishes put into the cupboard. The dishes would hold this odor, even when completely dry, unless we rinsed and dried all the dishes by hand or set them all out on the counter for 3 days to air out.On my first 2 warranty service calls to LG, 5-12-21 and 6-7-21, the technicians recognized an odor but could find no mechanical issues with the machine. The 3rd time I called, on 6-7-2021, LG refused to send someone to my house, saying that they would not send someone for the same issue since they found nothing at the last service call. (Incidentally, a technician told me that if LG has to send someone 3 times for the same issue, the policy is to replace the machine.)For the next 2 years, despite efforts to clean and drain the machine, try different cycles, and various dish washing products, the smell continued to get worse and worse. Eventually, when we opened the dishwasher after any cleaning cycle, our entire downstairs would reek like a riverbank. The only thing that helped somewhat was running a cycle with the dishwasher empty and some Clorox bleach in the bottom. That was only effective for one load following the bleach load.We have lived in our home for over 30 years and had two previous dishwashers with no problems. The only time I have ever smelled this swamp odor in my home was several years ago when I left a pitcher of water undisturbed and unrefrigerated for about a month. It produced a thin slimy film and that very characteristic submerged-vegetation-in-a-swamp odor.On 6-23-2023, I tried again to get some satisfaction from LG. After several calls, hours on the phone and weeks of waiting, my case was escalated to the Presidential Liaison. I was told that the best they could do was give me a courtesy check for $100 for my troubles, and a rebate for 20% of the machine cost. I expected $100 plus $206. I did receive the $100 check, and then I received a coupon off the price of my next LG appliance purchase for $58 with a notice that the case was closed. After 2½ years of dealing with stench, we replaced the LG dishwasher with a Bosch model a couple weeks ago – NO MORE SMELL.I have read reviews on LG and found that this issue is not unique to our machine. I believe I know what is causing the problem, which comes from the factory. Dishwashers are tested at the factory to be sure they function correctly. A portion of that water remains in the machine until it is installed and used by a customer. I believe that impure water was introduced into my washing machine and bacteria multiplied inside it, to the point where it cannot be rinsed or washed away without taking the machine apart.

Sentence (English): I had a GE washer installed by the builder.
Comments (English): [ Nice machine. Step up from GE. ] || ---------------- || I had a GE washer installed by the builder. After only 6 years, I had to replace it. I decided on this Maytag hoping it will last longer than the GE. I purchased it online so I didn't see it in person prior to it being installed in my home. It is very sleek looking even with front controls. My last machine had top controls that I didn't love. The inside is very shiny and looks pretty. The baskets are very roomy and the tines are placed perfectly. I don't see a need to have to fold them which is not an option on this machine but who cares? It has all the wash options that I need. I like to delay for a couple of hours when I wash, but this machine has a 4 hour delay only. I wish I could delay for only 2 hours but, again, it's is fine. It seems pretty quiet. You know it's running when it's on, but it doesn't require you to raise your voice to talk over it. Overall, I'm very pleased. I hope to be so for many years to come.

Sentence (English): Dishwasher 5/5 stars Delivery/Install experience 0/5 stars We love our dishwasher, but the whole reason we ordered from costco was because the amazing deal included delivery and installation.
Comments (English): [ Love our Dishwasher- Delivery/Install was TERRIBLE ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher 5/5 stars Delivery/Install experience 0/5 stars We love our dishwasher, but the whole reason we ordered from costco was because the amazing deal included delivery and installation. We typically pickup and install our own things but I thought it would be nice not to worry about it for once. Well turns out in Wisconsin Costco does not install their own dishwashers and contract the service out to someone called Handy…and that's when things start to go wrong. We scheduled the appointment for delivery/install and when the day finally comes I get a text/email reminder that the delivery is tomorrow and I will receive a phone call with the delivery window details. I never received a call so I reached out to Costco. They look through the information and tell me that the install is pushed back and scheduled for the next day because Handy could not find a contractor. He gave me the delivery date and time so I told my husband and he stayed home the next day. Next day rolls around again I receive an email to expect delivery and…nothing so I call Costco again. Handy canceled and rescheduled again without reaching out….long story short this horrible situation went on for 2 weeks. Comments (English): [ Fabulous dishwasher ! ] || ---------------- || I've had about a half-dozen dishwashers over the years (decades), and this one is by far the best. It's also great for dinner knives, prep knives and other sharps that I like to keep isolated for my safety. This fits into my busy life much better ! All in all, I would certainly recommend this dishwasher and I would NEVER want to be without a 3rd rack.
